rationale: C03, C04, and C25 share the child's amendment-by-addition format, including language such as “is hereby further amended,” “adding thereto,” and “the following new” provision. Those similarities are routine amendatory drafting formulas, however. None supplies the child's distinctive substantive machinery: authorizing the Secretary of the Army to conduct experimental ration plans and tests under terms and conditions he prescribes. The candidates concern unrelated regulatory additions, security criteria, or defense-procurement administration and do not reproduce a material sequence or adapted administrative mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: is hereby further amended by adding thereto the following new part
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subpart H of Part 21 of the said regulations is amended by adding thereto the following new section
shared_material.explanation: C03 has the closest amendment-by-addition structure, but this is a conventional formula rather than evidence of a substantive template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: is hereby further amended by adding thereto the following new part
shared_material.parent_excerpt: is hereby amended by adding thereto at the end thereof paragraph (8) as follows
shared_material.explanation: C04 uses a closely parallel formula for inserting a quoted provision, but the shared material is only routine amendatory language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: as amended, is hereby further amended by adding thereto the following new part
shared_material.parent_excerpt: as amended, is hereby further amended by adding after section 309 thereof ... the following new sections
shared_material.explanation: C25 shares several verbal elements and the insertion of new sections, but its extensive procurement machinery has no material counterpart in the child.
